Application Data.NAME: Ace Hardware
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Ace Hardware operates as a retail hardware and home improvement store, providing a wide range of products including tools, building materials, paint, and home improvement supplies. Our inventory is carefully managed, with current stock valued under $500,000, and secured by a centrally monitored alarm system to minimize theft risk. We do not offer on-site equipment rental or repair services, which helps limit our exposure to liability claims. Our store adheres to strict safety protocols, resulting in a low frequency of slip-and-fall incidents. We focus on providing quality products and exceptional customer service while maintaining effective financial stability and risk management practices.
